alt.ar: جدول تخصيصات سنة ٢٠٢٦ في Genoa Gov ببيانات تجريبية: تخصيص وزارة المالية والإضافة والتنزيل والتخصيص المعدَّل والمصروف والمتبقي ونسبة الإنجاز لكل حساب.
alt.en: The 2026 allocations table in Genoa Gov with demo data, showing each expenditure line's allocation, additions, reductions, revised allocation, spending, remaining allocation and share spent.

alt.en: The issued-but-uncleared cheques report in Genoa Gov with demo data, linking each cheque to its payment voucher, payee, amount and age in days.

alt.en: The legislation library in Genoa Gov with demo data, listing sample instructions, guides and circulars with their type, date, issuer and status, including one repealed by newer instructions.

alt.en: The Genoa Gov platform admin page listing the demo offices, each with its own separate database, status, release and last update, without showing any of their accounting data.

alt.en: The Genoa Gov office dashboard with demo data, showing available allocations, bank book balances, open advances, vouchers awaiting action and budget execution.

alt.en: The month-close screen in Genoa Gov with demo data, showing October closed after all its checks passed: no unposted vouchers, bank reconciliation certificates issued and the data audit passed.

alt.en: A posted payment voucher whose amount was amended in Genoa Gov with demo data, with its amendment history showing the original and amended versions, the reason and who took each step.

alt.ar: شاشة مستند صرف مصادق عليه في Genoa Gov ببيانات تجريبية، تعرض سلسلة المنظم والمدقق وآمر الصرف وخطوة الترحيل التالية.
alt.en: An approved payment voucher in Genoa Gov with demo data, showing its maker, auditor and authorizing-officer chain and the posting step that comes next.
